title: flow value envelopes refuse with condition wording: the date-text verdicts say "when the condition runs … a flow condition" at an update_record / create_record / assignment value slot
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQAXHSQEgnYyx9tstb

Filing gate: ① measured. Found in the #34451 dev round (PR #34654, open question 1). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #34451
Suggested-grade: p3 — the refusal is right and its fix hint is right; only the sentence names the wrong kind of slot.

## What

PR #34654 lets the date-text verdicts reach a flow value envelope (`assignment` values, `create_record` / `update_record` `fields.*`). It reuses the existing `date-text-call-run-may-fail` / `date-text-arithmetic-run-may-fail` codes, whose shared sentence reads "when the condition runs … a flow condition that cannot be evaluated fails the run". At a value slot there is no condition: the slot computes a value, and the run fails when it is evaluated. The location and the leading value-envelope sentence name the slot, so an author can still act, but the outcome sentence describes another kind of slot.

## Where (after #34654)

- `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`: `flowValueEnvelopeDateTextIssue` maps the family onto the `-run-may-fail` arm.
- The refusal-code ledger in `packages/formula/src/expression-refusal.ts` (and its catalogue readers): a value-slot arm would be a new code.

## Done when

A value-envelope refusal says the run fails when the value is computed, not when a condition runs; the codes are registered in the ledger; lint and `registerFlow` keep one verdict.

Dedupe words: value envelope refusal wording, date-text run-may-fail condition sentence, flowValueEnvelopeDateTextIssue message.
